The '''snare pistol''' was cord-shooting weapon designed to ensnare a target so that they can be captured alive. The pistol fired a length of [[Ultra-light micro-woven synthecord|synthcord]] which wrapped around the target, hindering its ability to move or escape. The snare pistol was a smaller version of the [[Snare rifle/Legends|snare rifle]] and the [[snare gun]].<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" />

Snare pistols were equipped onto [[B4J4 security droid]]s, which were designed mainly for non-lethal protection within corporate buildings.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" />

The snare pistol weighed 2 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and was able to fire 2 shots before needing to be reloaded. The weapon cost 600 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Replacement cartridges weighed 1 kilogram and cost 25 credits each.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" />
